summary: Wrote Lab 4 (PINN for the damped oscillator, 8 steps, 9 code blocks) and Lab 5 (contrastive pretraining on synthetic vibration windows, 7 steps, 7 code blocks) in src\en\module_05\21-labs-b.md. Runtimes measured on the loaded shared machine: Lab 4 133 s (3.4 ms/step), Lab 5 32 s. Both labrun runs report ALL LABS MATCH; check.mjs reports 0 errors. Prose agrees with the real outputs.
changes: Lab 4: step 6 non-dimensional run is not faster early (error 0.39 at 2,500, 0.061 at 5,000 vs 0.015 for the weighted run); it ends ten times lower (0.0004 vs 0.0039). Initial non-dimensional residual 0.034 is much smaller than the IC term 1.36, so the prose says the imbalance reverses rather than being 'comparable'.
Lab 4: lambda=100 error 0.0153 at 5,000 and 0.0039 at 10,000; zeta 0.0987 vs curve_fit 0.0977 +/- 0.0015, as the plan.

Lab 5: FFT baseline measured 0.850/0.899/0.974 (plan 0.790/0.890/0.975); untrained h 0.532/0.738/0.895; contrastive h 0.955/0.989/0.997 (plan 0.929/0.989/0.996), so the margin over FFT at 5 labels is about 10 points, not 14; seeds 1,2 give 0.952, 0.942. z probe 0.605/0.914/0.997.

Lab 5 ablation: no-shift 0.628/0.813/0.977, no augmentation 0.580/0.750/0.944; the confusion matrix errors are much smaller than the plan's (misalignment->imbalance 8 of 473, bearing->healthy 19 of 490). Added the observation that the no-shift and no-augmentation pretraining losses are lower (1.75, 1.70) than the full recipe (2.38).
Lab 5 bearing-defect spectrum is a comb at multiples of 3.57 f_r (about 39 and 78 Hz), not a 60 Hz hump; prose corrected. Wide-gain extension measured: 0.957/0.989/0.998.
Plan's 'tau, batch' extension numbers were not quoted since not re-run.
issues: Sections 9 and 11 and the exercise e12 did not yet exist in the part files when written; the labs link to #s9, #s11 and #e12, and the prose assumes Section 11 contains the worked example with similarities (0.9, 0.2, 0.1, -0.3) and the 6/9 rotation example, and Section 9 the trivial-solution failure and adaptive weighting.
Lab 5 confusion matrix is from the last of five probe draws only; counts vary by draw.
Lab 4 runtime scales with machine load (3.4 ms/step here against 1.2 ms in the prototype).
